'''Medium cruiser''' was a designation for a type of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Medium cruisers were often used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to protect [[troop line]]s.<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
